reviews.text: Entire staff is amazing!

My dog Maverick was experiencing head shaking and ear irritation due to allergies. I had a wonderful first-time experience at Modern Animal! Hannah and Dr. Averbach took such great care of Maverick and made us feel comfortable throughout the visit. I was greeted and acknowledged upon approval. I especially appreciated how they took the time to examine, explain the cost of care upfront and clearly, so I knew what to expect. It made the entire experience feel transparent and stress-free. I also liked that the owner can be present while care is being given. Thank you for providing such great care to Maverick. He’s feeling much better already! 🐾❤️
Modern Animal is great!
I visited Modern Animal because I needed travel docs for my dog. Doctors are truly experienced, I got all what I needed and the service was great.

Loved this place and my cat Bingo did too. It was super clean smelled pleasant and the staff were beautiful souls as well! Will definitely recommend this place to anyone with an animal that want optimal care they loved on my baby like he was theirs!

Dr. Lucia Auerbacht was a great veterinarian! She took the time to thoroughly check out my senior Corgi and helped me understand the different options available to support his health. I really appreciated how caring, thorough, and helpful she was throughout the visit. Also the Nurses were also fantastic!!
The whole staff is so wonderful and we our second time in quick kind and great care for my Hudson

Dr. Ashley Auerbach & team are the absolute best! I unfortunately have had to take my fur baby multiple times this year (check up, ear infection, allergies & back injury) & each time they have made me feel like they truly care. I always feel better after having Jameson in their hands and know he has the best care.

We love Modern Animal but we especially love Taylor and Dr. Auerbach!!! They’ve taken such wonderful care of our 2 GSPs and the only people I trust!! They are so knowledgeable, kind and caring and I can’t recommend them enough!! They’ve gotten us through 2 ACL surgery’s,  the puppy phase and much much more! 10/10 care from Taylor and Dr. Ashley!

In the forty plus years we have lived in Dallas with one, two or sometimes three English Labs under foot, I have never been SO repeatedly pleased with a vet clinic!  As an RN, some of my medical background can be helpful in understanding canine illnesses and injuries, yet Modern Animal (Park Cities/Lovers Lane) is exceptional in every way on explaining the illness, injury or other concerns!  Dr Ashley and the staff are knowledgable problem solvers, current on new medication options and feeding dog chow vendors. There are no surprise charges; they welcome you by name; and are exceptional in all ways in caring for our furry family members!
Taylor and her team do such a great job with Archie every time we’re at the clinic. I highly recommend them

Best in Show
Dr. Auerbach and Hannah—who I believe was the veterinary assistant, and apologies if I’ve gotten her title wrong—at Modern Animal are absolutely best in show.
From the moment we walked in, it was first-class treatment. Water? Coffee? Tea? At one point I wasn’t sure if I was at the vet or on a really unusual first date. All that was missing was someone asking my sign.
I actually brought in two dogs in the same day, so by round two I was experiencing a little déjà woof.
Dog #1 was sick, and what I appreciated most was that Dr. Auerbach laid out the best treatment options without trying to sniff around my wallet. The focus was clearly on what my dog actually needed—not piling on unnecessary tests and charges just because they could. Sadly, that makes Modern Animal a bit of a rare breed.
Dog #2 apparently needs to lose a few pounds. I suggested a treadmill. They suggested an actual weight-loss plan. This is probably why they're the professionals.
Everyone we encountered was warm, loving, patient, and genuinely seemed to care about the animals. No barking up the wrong tree, no unnecessary charges, no dog-and-pony show.
Just exceptional care from people who clearly give a Shih Tzu.
Five paws up. Would absolutely let them treat my pack again.
Thanks for the fantastic rating, Jonathan! We're glad to see you enjoyed your experience.
Thanks for the fantastic rating, Kevin! We're glad to see you enjoyed your experience. Your support means a lot to us, and we look forward to welcoming you back soon!

I came in to get my buddy Claude's vaccines and yearly check up and both Hannah and Dr. Auerbach were the best care team you could ask for. They were very kind and respectful, and both were very sweet and gentle with my furry friend. 10 stars

I travel a lot due to work, and this place is by far the best. The staff here is amazing and I get the peace of mind of multiple locations when I travel. Love this place and the way they care for my dogs
They are professional, courteous, and compassionate. You can tell that they truly care about the health of your pets and the quality of the services they provide.

HIGHLY RECOMMEND

This place was amazing
(All female staff which my animals loved)

The staff was incredible with my dogs and were so friendly with me as well.
Being at the vet is always a little stressful with two large dogs but they were amazing

ALSO - they helped inform me on what care would be best for my dogs and actually listened to me about my precious experience with a vet a had a bad experience with!

And the pricing was awesome. Much better than I’ve been charged at AWFUL vet clinics.

We will be only coming here from here on out!
10/10!!
Dr. Auerbach and all the modern animal staff are the absolute best! They always take the best care of my pup!

Best veterinarian clinic I have ever attended! They saved my baby’s life! I won’t go anywhere else! Dr Ashley is amazing and very good at what she does! She gained my trust instantly and I’m so thankful she’s treating all my babies!

I’ve been going to Modern Animal for about two years now but this was my first visit to the Park Cities location. Dr. Kim was really sweet and loved my cats. Cassie was our vet tech this visit and she was great! She gave me all of the info I needed to make sure my cats were taken care of. This location is a bit of a drive for me but I’ll definitely keep it in mind when my usual clinic is booked!
Best vet my dogs have been to . Definitely recommend getting vet care here.

I would like to start this review off by saying that we have the All-Access membership and believe anyone with a puppy for the first time NEEDS this membership. You have 24/7 access to someone who can answer your questions and give advice, as well as many other benefits.

Our puppy has had an upset stomach with diarrhea and vomiting for over a week now. She had to go to the ER at the beginning of the week and we just felt like she wasn't getting better so we inquired about any available appointments on a Saturday and there was none. However, with the specific membership we have, you get some priority. They asked us to bring her in, in the morning and that she would be seen between appointments.

We appreciate how they took care of our puppy and how well they communicated through the app! Would highly recommend any of the Modern Animal facilities in Dallas to anyone.

I cannot say enough wonderful things about the veterinary team at Modern Animal Park Cities. The compassion they showed me and my two beloved cats during one of the most difficult times of my life.
From the beginning of our palliative care journey, they treated not just my cats, but the entire situation, with such empathy, patience and respect.
On the day I had to say goodbye, they created a calm, peaceful environment and treated my cats with such tenderness and love.
I wholeheartedly recommend them to anyone looking for a veterinary team that truly cares, not just for the animals, but for the people who love them.
Absolutely love this practice and Dr. Auerbach!

We have a French bulldog which can be a task with allergies and sickness! They make us feel so at ease with anything that ever happens. They have literally sat on the floor with me and my dog to make sure I feel confident in the care of my dog. It’s so clean, easy to book and seamless when we visit. Would highly recommend to anyone - they have a ton of Dallas locations also.

Awesome vet.   I had a vet in far North Dallas but my previous dog needed weekly treatment for kidney failures so used Modern Animal.  Both the technician and the vet were great - providing great care, taking time to explain, and reasonable pricing.  The app makes everything easy as well.   They are now my permanent vet.

Staff are always friendly, but be cautious of unauthorized charges. My goldendoodle had eye surgery and was billed over $500 for dental work I didn’t approve. Prior messages through their system with the vet indicated he didn’t need it, but they performed the work anyway during his stay. I received no response when I reached out, not even an acknowledgment.
I brought my cat here for the first time and the office was really nice and clean. Staff was friendly and the price was very reasonable. No wait time! Awesome experience here I’ll definitely be back.

We had a wonderful visit! Both the Dr and Vet Tech were very patient and sweet with our shy/scared dog. The office and exam room were super clean. Very transparent about pricing of services and were honest about what they recommended and thought could wait. Everyone was wonderful and I highly recommend!

Fantastic experience for my senior dog! Dr. Auerbach and tech Cassandra treated us with care, compassion, and enthusiasm. My dog loved the peanut butter treat and felt at ease with the team. I highly recommend this clinic and all they have to offer. We will be back!
Great place. Doctor Auerbach is very attentive and makes the dog feel very welcome.

10/10 Experience at Modern Animal and I can't recommend them enough. Super friendly and informative staff, great environment and tactful cost transparency. Ashley & Cassandra take such great care of our pups and have earned our business for years to come.
The way Modern Animal handled my angel dog’s end of life care was exceptional. They went above and beyond - we are so grateful.

Love this place so much. They are attentive to your pets needs and are flexible with your approach to care. All their employees genuinely care about your pets. Dr. Auerbach is exceptional, making sure my girl Frances is at her best. Cassie, one of their techs, is so sweet to us… I see her every time and she so wonderful in assisting us. The entire staff here is amazing, you cannot go wrong with who you see here. They are all quick to get you seen and provide the highest level of care to you and your pup. Thank you Modern Animal at Lovers Ln for your care!

This is one of the best clinics I have ever been to! You are greeted with the upmost compassion and they are truly there to listen and help with any and all concerns. Everyone on the staff was friendly and inviting, as well as took every measure to make sure my kitty was comfortable. The prices are also very affordable and they are transparent about everything, they also take their time with you to cover everything! Please consider taking your animal here, they will give them the highest level of care! I won’t be going anywhere else from now on!!
I love how sweet the staff was this was first time visiting and couldn’t have asked for a better experience
My dog really enjoyed the friendly staff. It might not look like it in the picture but she did enjoy being in there there's no cold silver little tables they work with the animals on the floor

I happened to stumble across this clinic on an Instagram ad and couldn’t be happier the experience I had brining my cat here. He is an extremely high stress animal when it comes to vet visits, and I have never seen him so calm at a vet. I highly recommend this clinic for anyone with anxious fur babies.

We had a truly exceptional experience with Dr. Auerbach and her team during our recent visit. From the moment we arrived, it was clear that this clinic prioritizes not just excellent medical care, but also the emotional well-being of the animals they treat.

Dr. Auerbach was timely, professional, and incredibly friendly. This was our cat’s very first vet visit, and thanks to the Fear Free techniques they use, it couldn’t have gone more smoothly. She took the time to approach our cat gently and calmly, creating a stress-free environment that made her feel safe and at ease in what could have been a scary situation. The technician assisting her was equally kind and thoughtful, which made a big difference.

I’ve also brought my dog in previously for a medical issue, and once again, the staff went above and beyond—not only to get us seen quickly but also to explain everything clearly and thoroughly. They were attentive, responsive, and compassionate every step of the way.

The clinic’s use of Fear Free practices—like calm handling, treats, and a soothing atmosphere—really sets them apart. It’s obvious they care deeply about both the physical and emotional health of the animals they treat.

I highly recommend Dr. Auerbach and the entire team at this clinic for any veterinary needs. Their combination of top-notch care, empathy, and dedication is something every pet owner hopes to find.

Modern Animal has been a great find for us. High-touch and great people - the app & ability to have a nurse chat with you 24x7 is a game changer. We’ve been to all 3 Dallas clinics now, they’re all great!

I seriously cannot say enough good things about Modern Animal. All of the Dr.’s and nurses have been amazing. We followed our vet here bc we absolute love her and now we have fallen in love with everyone. The way they take the time with you, listen and show the love and affection for our babies is truly unmatched. Just had a teeth cleaning yesterday and they kept me up to date through every step beginning to end and take charges off based on what was needed. They also have 24/7 telecom which has come in handy a few times. I have two senior dogs and I know they are getting the best care that we can get them.

We’ve trusted Dr. Ashley Auerbach with our 12-year-old Maltese, Coco, for two years. Her patience, clear explanations, and heartfelt care for Coco’s age-related health issues make her exceptional. Dr. Ashley treats Coco like her own, and we’re so grateful for her kindness. After she moved to Modern Animal, we followed her and couldn’t be happier with the clinic’s caring staff and excellent facilities. Highly recommend Dr. Ashley and Modern Animal—5 stars!
Great experience at Modern Animal! They took great care of my girl and made us both feel comfortable.
Dr Auerbach and staff are wonderful at the Park Cities location. It’s a very welcoming hospital with great staff. Completely recommend them for your pets care!
Great vet
Wonderful experience! The app makes it easy to communicate with the staff and I love that they are fear free!

This place takes the cake. I truly believe modern animal is the best in its class. The entire experience from when you walk into the doors was impeccable. From the decor to the care 10/10! Extremely clean and no lingering smells like most places. The nurses and technicians were incredible! They explained everything in great detail. After our first experience today we are lifetime members of this place and the membership goodie back with additional information around next steps through the app was great! Love it here.  Thank you again!
Hi Laura, thank you for your review. We are thrilled you had a great experience with us and hope to see you again soon!
Hi Shannon, thank you for your review. We are thrilled you had a great experience with us and hope to see you again soon!
Couldn’t be happier thus far. Nice to have a non-VCA option so close and being able to get in same day is awesome.

This team knows how to surprise and delight!

Hannah was our nurse and she was exceptional. It had been a few months since I've brought my pup in and we had several things going on that we wanted addressed. She was very thorough in her history taking and clearly reviewed the chart since she was confirming historical prescriptions and validating my pup's previous medical history. She was also very empathetic and didn't make me feel bad for being worried about so many little things.

Dr. Auerbach was so kind and thoughtful in her approach. She took time to address each of my concerns and make sure that I felt confident about the path forward. I think she helped set great expectations for me on what to look out for and what the next steps are in the future.

I loved how everyone approached my pup and allowed him time to warm up and get comfortable before they did anything. Brittany, the manager, even came in and made sure to introduce herself and ask if there was anything else they the team could do to make our visit great (nothing else needed to be done- the visit was great!). You can see the emphasize on patient care and compassion for pet owners.

We reviewed so much and did testing, so I was expecting my bill to be 3-4x higher than what it was. It was great to know we had everything done and it didn't break the bank. I will definitely be returning to see this awesome team! 10/10 recommend the Park Cities Modern Animal clinic for your veterinary needs!!

I love coming to Modern Animal with my fur babies! Dr. Dammicci is always so attentive and sensitive to our concerns and has many options for us to try. Alex got us in a room and got our concerns and really took time to listen to us to ensure all the information was talked about. Modern Animal always can get us in for an appointment in a timely manner and we rarely have a wait while there! I cannot recommend them enough!
Our first visit.  The staff  and Dr Dammicci were professional , friendly & truly met Madison's needs.

During my visit with Liky for her corneal ulcer, I had an excellent experience thanks to Kaiyah, the vet assistant, and Dr. Auerbach. Kaiyah was incredibly nice and understanding, taking the time to explain everything clearly and making sure Liky felt as comfortable as possible. Her patience was evident throughout the visit, and she used Fear Free techniques that helped put Liky at ease, which I greatly appreciated.

Dr. Auerbach was equally amazing—very informative and considerate of Liky’s medical conditions. She took the time to answer all my questions efficiently and made me feel confident in the treatment plan. Overall, the care and professionalism shown by both Kaiyah and Dr. Auerbach made a stressful situation much easier. Highly recommend this team!
Hi Rita, thank you for your review. We are thrilled you had a great experience with us and hope to see you again soon!

I had an amazing experience with Dr. Robson, Niko (VN), and Nicole (LVN). They were fantastic with our dogs and patient when answering all of our questions. Although we recently moved away, we truly miss this care team. Also, the online portal was so helpful when we had concerns after hours. They were very helpful and thorough with our pets. I highly recommend Modern Animal!
Best Vet in Dallas! I am very pleased - they recently went out of their way for me, and I will always use them moving forward.

Alex and Dr. Dammicci are the absolute best!! Having 2 Frenchies we are in quite a bit and the attention to detail and friendliness of Alex always calms down our nervous one. Don't know what I did without MA before!!
really loved how they cared about my cat and the communication between the Vet and me. Place is neat and clean. Would visit again!

A$AP and I had the best experience at Modern Animal! Our appointment was the grand opening, we showed up a little early but the vet tech Alex ( who was AMAZING) saw us immediately! He was super friendly answered all my questions and offered great tips! Dr Dammicci was also very kind and explained the purpose of all the vaccines.
